OLD RIGHT OF PASSAGE — the Surveyor's next attempt to cash a Claim comes to nothing, and the Claim remains. OLD MEASURE — remove up to 8 of the Surveyor's Block.

counter_petition.FlavorText: Once a turn, spend 1 Safe-Conduct to argue one of the Ombudsman's complaints under the other Ground — Road becomes Root, or Root becomes Road. It creates nothing, moves nothing, and nobody's standing changes hands.

spend_a_counterseal.FlavorText: Spend 1 Counterseal to prise one Notarial Seal back out of the wood. The ring returns to ordinary rotation; the Weight of Precedent already earned stays where it is.

right_of_audience.FlavorText: Once a turn, spend Favour. ONE — strike one of the Queen's Claims off. TWO — her law is suspended for the rest of this turn. THREE — her guard is struck away and her granted name is prepared, which takes 8 off her final order.

near_boundary.FlavorText: Accept the surveyor's nearer figure as this turn's exact measure. Meeting it lets it brace.

far_boundary.FlavorText: Accept the surveyor's further figure as this turn's exact measure. Meeting it costs it 10 HP and strips its cover.

break_the_ration_seal.FlavorText: Break open the ration chamber: 1 Energy on your next turn. The colony eats too — it gains 1 Strength.

break_the_pest_seal.FlavorText: Break open the pest chamber: the colony loses 12 HP, and what was living in there gets on you — 2 Poison.

break_the_burden_seal.FlavorText: Break open the burden chamber: 1 Burdened comes off you, or 1 Paperwork if you carry no burden. The colony packs the breach — 12 Block when its turn comes.

draw_against_the_treasury.FlavorText: Spend a Treasury Credit: take up to 12 Block off the treasury. Once a turn.

settle_the_burden.FlavorText: Spend a Treasury Credit: 1 Burdened is settled and comes off you. Once a turn.

the_answer_of_measure.FlavorText: Answer the sphinx by walking to a figure: 2 Weighed. One Answer Mark.

the_answer_of_burden.FlavorText: Answer the sphinx by carrying it: 2 Burdened. One Answer Mark.

the_answer_of_burial.FlavorText: Answer the sphinx by being packed down and filed: 1 Entombed and 1 Paperwork. One Answer Mark.

the_measured_foundation.FlavorText: Accept this blueprint: spend exactly 2 Energy this turn. Met, the Monument falls a step; missed, it climbs one and you are Entombed.

the_equal_courses.FlavorText: Accept this blueprint: play exactly 2 Deeds this turn. Met, the Monument falls a step; missed, you are Burdened.

the_alternating_stone.FlavorText: Accept this blueprint: the first two cards you play must be of different kinds. Met, the Monument falls a step; missed, 2 Paperwork.

the_measured_course.FlavorText: Accept the fallback course: spend exactly what the Architect has measured for this turn. Met, the Monument falls a step; missed, it climbs one.

break_the_granary_reserve_seal.FlavorText: She can no longer take Grain, and no longer eats. You heal 5.

break_the_granary_labor_seal.FlavorText: An over-ration can no longer burden you. One Burdened comes off.

break_the_granary_record_seal.FlavorText: A failed ration can no longer be written up. Up to 2 Paperwork comes off.

break_the_granary_ration_seal.FlavorText: From now on every exact ration costs her 10 blood and 10 cover. She loses 10 cover now.

scrape_the_first_entry.FlavorText: Blank this entry on the scroll. One entry a turn, and the correction is written up: 1 Paperwork.

scrape_the_second_entry.FlavorText: Blank this entry on the scroll. One entry a turn, and the correction is written up: 1 Paperwork.

scrape_the_third_entry.FlavorText: Blank this entry on the scroll. One entry a turn, and the correction is written up: 1 Paperwork.

wash_the_weighed_vessel.FlavorText: Pay 1 Energy: the jar holding Weighed is emptied and cannot come back. You are Embalmed 1 for handling it. One jar a turn.

wash_the_burdened_vessel.FlavorText: Pay 1 Energy: the jar holding Burdened is emptied and cannot come back. You are Embalmed 1 for handling it. One jar a turn.

wash_the_entombed_vessel.FlavorText: Pay 1 Energy: the jar holding Entombed is emptied and cannot come back. You are Embalmed 1 for handling it. One jar a turn.

wash_the_inscribed_vessel.FlavorText: Pay 1 Energy: the jar holding Inscribed is emptied and cannot come back. You are Embalmed 1 for handling it. One jar a turn.

wash_the_paperwork_vessel.FlavorText: Pay 1 Energy: the jar holding Paperwork is emptied and cannot come back. You are Embalmed 1 for handling it. One jar a turn.

wash_the_doubt_vessel.FlavorText: Pay 1 Energy: the jar holding Doubt is emptied and cannot come back. You are Embalmed 1 for handling it. One jar a turn.

silence_the_royal_seal.FlavorText: The Royal Seal office says nothing until the Vizier's next action is over. One office only — the sheets are gone at the end of the turn either way.

silence_the_tally.FlavorText: The Tally office says nothing until the Vizier's next action is over. One office only — the sheets are gone at the end of the turn either way.

silence_the_inner_stair.FlavorText: The Inner Stair office says nothing until the Vizier's next action is over. One office only — the sheets are gone at the end of the turn either way.

work_the_sluice.FlavorText: Spend 1 Sluice Authority: at the end of this turn, after the river answers your Energy, it moves one step back toward the Ordered Flood. Once a turn.

counter_petition_twine_action.FlavorText: Discard a card, draw a card, and gain 1 Energy. Once a turn.

honey_spoon_action.FlavorText: Gain 2 Energy. Then end the turn with at least 1 Energy, or the spoon costs you 6 HP.

better_chair_cushion_action.FlavorText: Gain 14 Block. Then end the turn holding a real card, or the cushion costs you 6 HP.

last_slice_tin_action.FlavorText: Draw 2. Then play no more than four real cards this turn, or the tin costs you 6 HP.

royal_grace_cup_action.FlavorText: Choose one: 1 Energy, a card, or 10 Block. Every enemy guards for 6. Once a turn.

silver_name_tally_action.FlavorText: Once a combat: one enemy's guard is gone, you gain 10 Block against what it was about to do, and the next card you play this turn is refunded.

edict_of_the_open_audience_action.FlavorText: Every card in your hand costs 0 for the rest of this turn. Once a combat.

erasure_tablet_action.FlavorText: Every enemy's next action is erased: it deals no damage, and they guard for 20 instead. Once a combat.

correction_reed_action.FlavorText: Send a card away and take one back out of your discard pile; it costs 1 less this turn. With nothing to take back, draw 1. Once a turn.

vacant_throne_decree_action.FlavorText: Gain 3 Energy, draw 3, and gain 20 Block. Once a combat.

sluice_gate_of_the_two_lands_action.FlavorText: Open the gate — lose 12 Block for 1 Energy — or close it — spend 1 Energy for 12 Block. You must be able to pay in full. Once a turn.

black_flood_vessel_action.FlavorText: Discard your hand, draw 7, and gain 2 Energy. Once a combat.

clause_extension.FlavorText:
Sign: gain 1 Energy. Liability: 1 Fatigue when the record is read.
Refuse: the Petition gains 8 Block.

clause_protective.FlavorText:
Sign: gain 10 Block. Liability: 2 Paperwork when the record is read.
Refuse: the Petition gains 1 Strength.

clause_evidentiary.FlavorText:
Sign: draw 2 cards. Liability: 1 Doubt and 1 Paperwork when the record is read.
Refuse: the Petition gains 1 Strength.

acknowledge_service.FlavorText:
Sign for the notice: gain 2 Paperwork. The Knight's enforcement deals 10 instead of 19 and 1 Paperwork.
Leave it in hand to refuse.

file_the_request.FlavorText: Resolve the Request for Additional Review.

petition_for_priority.FlavorText:
Move one place toward the Counter. Gain 1 Paperwork.
Only one administrative choice per turn.

yield_your_place.FlavorText:
Move one place away from the Counter. Gain 6 Block.
Only one administrative choice per turn.

ask_for_expedited_service.FlavorText: This Service Window opens the Commissioner by 15 % instead of 25 %, but afterwards you stand at Position 1 instead of going back into the queue.

break_the_seal_of_access.FlavorText: Shatter the Great Seal of Access and take its Fragment.

break_the_seal_of_testimony.FlavorText: Shatter the Great Seal of Testimony and take its Fragment.

break_the_seal_of_execution.FlavorText: Shatter the Great Seal of Execution and take its Fragment.

fragment_of_access.FlavorText: Remove up to 12 Block from the Lord Sealkeeper.

fragment_of_testimony.FlavorText: Remove 2 stacks of Paperwork from yourself.

fragment_of_execution.FlavorText: The Sealkeeper's next attack deals 8 less.

authorized_expedition.FlavorText:
Gain 1 Energy.
Costs 1 Authorization; one authority per turn.

authorized_entry.FlavorText:
Remove up to 12 Block from the Municipal Dragon.
Costs 1 Authorization; one authority per turn.

file_an_objection.FlavorText:
The Dragon's next attack deals 5 less.
Costs 1 Authorization; one authority per turn.

issue_a_citation.FlavorText:
Remove 1 Code Violation from the Dragon.
Costs 1 Authorization; one authority per turn.

strike_down_the_article.FlavorText: The Article is struck; the next prepared Article takes its place. The Charter gains 8 Block.

claim_an_exception.FlavorText: The Articles do not touch you for the rest of this turn.

return_receipt.FlavorText: Choose one: FILE THE RECEIPT — remove 1 Overdue; the Bell loses 5 HP. CONTEST THE FEE — remove 1 Late Fee; mark 1 draw-pile card Misfiled.

borrow_one_minute.FlavorText: Once per turn: push one filed hour back by 1 turn, to a maximum countdown of 3. Free while you hold a Free Adjustment.

self_inking_stamp.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, apply 2 Paperwork to all enemies.

suspiciously_helpful_stapler.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 8 Block.

minor_witching_license.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, apply 1 Doubt to all enemies.

stamped_lunchbox.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 5 Block.

cracked_wax_seal.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, apply 1 Paperwork to all enemies.

municipal_umbrella.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 7 Block.

moth_eaten_index.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, apply 1 Doubt to all enemies.

queue_token.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 4 Block and apply 1 Paperwork to all enemies.

gargoyle_chalk.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 9 Block.

red_ribbon_spool.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, apply 2 Paperwork to all enemies.

notary_candle.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 12 Block.

archive_lantern.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, apply 2 Doubt to all enemies.

clerk_badge.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Max Energy.

stone_counterweight.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 8 Block and apply 1 Doubt to all enemies.

bottomless_stamp_pad.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, apply 3 Paperwork to all enemies.

official_timepiece.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Max Energy.

grand_ledger_chain.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 10 Block. Card rewards contain 1 additional card.

charter_fragment.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, apply 2 Doubt and 1 Paperwork to all enemies.

deputy_signature.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 12 Block and apply 2 Paperwork to all enemies.

emergency_inkwell.FlavorText: Once per combat, after playing a card, if you have no Energy left, gain 1 Energy.

borrowed_authority.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Strength.

warm_waiting_room_bench.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, heal 3 HP.

forbidden_rubber_stamp.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Strength and 1 Paperwork.

counterfeit_priority_pass.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Energy and 1 Doubt.

official_break_room_key.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, heal 2 HP and gain 4 Block.

overtime_chit.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Energy and 4 Block.

junior_deputy_sash.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Strength and apply 1 Paperwork to all enemies.

overfilled_inbox.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, apply 2 Paperwork to all enemies and 1 Paperwork to yourself.

clerical_second_wind.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, heal 5 HP.

municipal_tax_stamp.FlavorText: Gain 5 additional Gold after each victorious combat.

toll_exemption_badge.FlavorText: Gain 10 additional Gold after each victorious combat.

vendor_license.FlavorText: Shop prices are reduced by 15%. When picked up, gain 25 Gold.

brass_filing_tray.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, add a Temporary Authorization to your hand.

deputy_seal.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, apply 1 Paperwork to all enemies and add a Form 12-B to your hand.

queue_bell.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 5 Block and apply 1 Doubt to all enemies.

carbon_copy_pad.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, add a Counter Signature to your hand and a Duplicate Copy to your discard pile.

archive_key.FlavorText: The first time each turn you Archive a Junk card, gain 5 Block and draw 1 card.

red_tape_dispenser.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Energy and add Red Tape to your hand.

permit_cabinet.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, add an Expedited Stamp to your hand.

bottomless_inbox_tray.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, apply 2 Paperwork to all enemies and add an Unsigned Form to your hand.

levy_stamp.FlavorText: When picked up, gain 30 Gold. After every victorious combat, gain 4 additional Gold.

brass_bookmark.FlavorText: The first card that enters your hand outside the normal draw each turn is kept until your next turn.

conservators_thread.FlavorText: The first time each turn a card leaves your hand without being played, gain 4 Block.

sun_warmed_waystone.FlavorText: If you end your turn with at least 1 unspent Energy, gain 5 Block.

five_notch_bead.FlavorText: Every fifth card played during combat deals 6 damage to the living enemy with the lowest HP.

formkeepers_signet.FlavorText: The first time each turn you play a Form, gain 2 Block and apply 1 additional Paperwork to its target.

moss_salve.FlavorText: After winning a combat in which you lost HP, heal up to 2 HP.

lead_counterweight.FlavorText: The first time each turn you play a card with base cost 2 or more, gain 4 Block.

hollow_wax_bead.FlavorText: Every third 0-cost card played during combat draws 1 card, at most once per turn.

binders_awl.FlavorText: The first time your draw pile is shuffled each combat, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card.

carved_bone_buckle.FlavorText: When picked up, gain 4 Max HP and heal 4 HP.

petitioners_token.FlavorText: The first time each combat a Queued card resolves, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card.

iron_prayer_bead.FlavorText: The first Deed you play each turn against an enemy that intends to Attack deals 4 additional damage.

tarnished_bell.FlavorText: The first time each turn you apply a negative status to an enemy, deal 4 damage to it.

grave_coin.FlavorText: Whenever an enemy dies while affected by a negative status, gain 4 Gold.

bruise_cup.FlavorText: The first time each turn an enemy causes you to lose HP, gain 4 Block.

votive_candle.FlavorText: The first Rite you play each combat costs 1 less Energy and grants 3 Block when played.

rootbound_walking_staff.FlavorText: At the start of your next combat after a non-combat node, gain 1 Energy and 6 Block.

counterfeit_toll_writ.FlavorText: When picked up, gain 30 Gold. Every shop purchase refunds 10 Gold.

ashen_wax_knife.FlavorText: The first time each turn you Exhaust a card, draw 1 card.

quiet_readers_cord.FlavorText: If you end your turn having played 2 or fewer cards, draw 1 additional card next turn.

redaction_knife.FlavorText: Once per turn, after your normal draw, discard 1 card and draw 1 card.

alms_basin.FlavorText: Heal 8 HP the first time you make a purchase in each shop.

index_bone.FlavorText: At the start of your turn, draw 1 additional card.

refusal_rosary.FlavorText: After every victorious combat, gain 10 Gold and heal 1 HP.

archive_censer.FlavorText: The first time each turn you Archive a card, gain 1 Energy.

seal_makers_die.FlavorText: The first time each turn you Ratify, draw 1 card and gain 5 Block.

blood_price_token.FlavorText: At the start of your turn, lose 3 HP; your next card that turn costs 1 less Energy.

blackthorn_brooch.FlavorText: The first time each turn a single card grants at least 10 Block, deal 6 damage to all enemies.

executioners_measure.FlavorText: After every victorious combat, gain 15 Gold.

sootglass_lens.FlavorText: The first time each turn you apply a negative status to an enemy that already had one, draw 1 card.

rubric_tablet.FlavorText: The first time each turn you play a Rite, your next card that turn costs 1 less Energy.

refuse_docket.FlavorText: The first time each turn a Junk card enters your hand, it is Archived and an enemy gains 1 Seal.

index_volvelle.FlavorText: At combat start, one card in your hand costs 1 less Energy the first time you play it.

withheld_hourglass.FlavorText: At the start of your turn, one card in your hand costs 0 Energy the first time you play it.

road_claim_token.FlavorText: When picked up, upgrade 1 card. After every victorious combat, heal 5 HP.

concordance_medallion.FlavorText: The first time each turn you apply Paperwork or Doubt to a single enemy, apply half of it to every other enemy, rounded down but never less than 1.

chancery_ribbon.FlavorText: The first Form you play each turn costs 1 less Energy. Paperwork and Doubt it applies are increased by 1.

iron_astrolabe.FlavorText: The first time each turn you draw cards, gain 1 Energy.

twin_ember_brazier.FlavorText: Whenever you Rest at a Campfire, upgrade 1 random unupgraded card. Whenever you Smith, heal 7 HP.

gilded_tithe_chain.FlavorText: When picked up, gain 4 Max HP and heal 4. Every shop purchase grants 2 Max HP.

rebinding_spindle.FlavorText: At the start of your turn, two cards in your hand cost 1 less Energy the first time they are played.

deferred_signet.FlavorText: The first card you Queue each turn applies 1 Seal to its target when it resolves.

blood_stamped_bond.FlavorText: At combat start, lose 6 HP and gain 1 Energy and 1 additional card on turn 1.

thorn_crowned_reliquary.FlavorText: Whenever you gain Block, deal damage equal to a quarter of it to the enemy with the most HP, at most 10 per gain.

blank_folio.FlavorText: When picked up, remove 1 card from your deck.

chancery_scale.FlavorText: The first time each turn you apply Paperwork to an enemy already 5 deep, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card.

pawnbrokers_loupe.FlavorText: Whenever a normal card reward is generated, one random card is Appraised: take it and gain 12 Gold. Skip the entire reward and gain 6 Gold.

copper_receipt_roll.FlavorText: After every third purchase made in Shops, gain 35 Gold. Card removal counts as a purchase.

secondhand_reliquary.FlavorText: The first time each Act you enter a Shop, one Normal Relic for sale is Secondhand: it costs 30% less, and buying it costs 5 HP.

bounty_hook.FlavorText: After defeating an Elite, gain 20 Gold — or 35 if you finished that combat below half your Max HP.

witchmarket_purse.FlavorText: At the end of each Act, gain 20 Gold for every full 100 Gold you own, up to 60 Gold.

bent_auction_gavel.FlavorText: Whenever a random Normal Relic is offered as a reward, you may reject it and gain 65 Gold instead. Boss, Event and purchased relics are excluded.

wastebrokers_permit.FlavorText: Whenever you Archive a card, record 1 Salvage, up to 3 per combat. After a victory, gain 5 Gold per Salvage.

filing_fee_stamp.FlavorText: At combat end, each enemy that died with 5+ Paperwork grants 6 Gold, and 4 more if it died with 10+. At most 20 Gold per combat.

scriveners_shears.FlavorText: The first card removal you buy each Act costs 50% less; the next one that Act costs 25% more.

apprentices_whetstone.FlavorText: Whenever you purchase a card, you may pay 20 additional Gold to upgrade it immediately.

backroom_kettle.FlavorText: Once per Shop visit, pay 25 Gold to heal 8 HP.

crooked_display_case.FlavorText: Adds one additional Normal Relic to this Shop and to every future Shop. The extra relic costs 20% more.

turnover_bell.FlavorText: Once per Shop visit, pay 30 Gold to replace all unsold cards with new ones. Relics and services are unaffected.

debtors_signet.FlavorText: You may buy what you cannot afford; the remainder becomes Debt, up to 100. While in Debt, half of any Gold you gain, rounded up, repays it.

notarys_waiver.FlavorText: Whenever you Ratify, gain 1 Waiver, up to 4. Each Waiver takes 10 Gold off a card removal, and buying one spends them all.

priority_window_pass.FlavorText: The first Form or Queue card in each Shop is 10% cheaper, and buying one refunds up to 15 of the Gold you actually paid.

twin_lock_chest_key.FlavorText: Whenever a Normal Relic is offered, two are revealed and you choose one.

appraisers_chalk.FlavorText: Whenever a normal card reward is generated, one of its cards is offered upgraded.

guest_favor_token.FlavorText: The first time each Act you resolve an Event, choose 25 Gold or upgrade a card in your deck.

merchant_punchcard.FlavorText: Entering a Shop earns 1 Punch, up to 3. Each Punch takes 20 Gold off a purchase.

warranty_tag.FlavorText: The first Relic you buy each Act is under warranty: the next Shop you enter refunds half the Gold you actually paid for it.

indemnity_stamp.FlavorText: When picked up, gain 20 Gold. Whenever you lose Gold outside a Shop, recover half of it, up to 50.

archive_voucher_roll.FlavorText: After winning a combat in which you Archived at least 2 cards, gain 1 Archive Voucher, up to 5. Each Voucher is 10 Gold of Shop credit.

departmental_purchase_order.FlavorText: Each Act, the first Deed, the first Working and the first Rite you buy each refund up to 15 of the Gold you actually paid.

originality_stamp.FlavorText: Once per combat, the first non-Junk card you play is copied into your hand, and your next card costs 1 less.

unclaimed_property_tag.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, one card in your draw pile costs 1 less this fight.

uncalled_ticket.FlavorText: Once per combat, a card still in your hand at the end of your turn goes back on top of your draw pile; next turn you gain 1 Energy and draw 1.

threshold_ward.FlavorText: Start each combat with 6 Block. The first time an enemy gains a positive status each combat, gain 1 Energy and 6 Block.

crossed_out_map.FlavorText: Once, you may walk to any node in the next row, ignoring the paths.

inherited_bone_folder.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, one card in your draw pile costs 1 less this fight, and you draw 1 extra card.

unreturned_library_card.FlavorText: Once each combat, a card you end your turn still holding is waiting in your hand next turn, and it is free.

reversible_shelf_label.FlavorText: Once each combat, the label remembers a card you put down unplayed. When it next reaches your hand you draw 1 and it costs 1 less.

blank_cameo.FlavorText: At each combat's opening one card in your hand is kept, costs 1 less, and cannot be marked by the archive.

vow_bead.FlavorText: End a turn having played exactly 3 non-Junk cards and your next turn gains 1 Energy and 1 card.

inverted_sealstone.FlavorText: At each combat's opening one Deed or Working is sealed: the first time you play it, it comes back to your hand.

mootcap.FlavorText: The third real card you play each turn is put to the circle, and it answers: 10 Block, a card, or 7 damage to everything standing.

dissenting_spore.FlavorText: An odd turn grows a spore and an even one costs you one. At three, the ring speaks: 1 Energy, an extra card and 6 Block.

antway_marker.FlavorText: Three real cards in a row, none cheaper than the one before: the third is worth 1 Energy and a card. Step out of order and the line is broken for the turn.

complaint_leaf.FlavorText: The first party to lay a hand on you is named the Respondent. While it is standing, one card in your hand each turn costs 1 less.

guest_right_brooch.FlavorText: You have been welcomed. Every combat opens with 8 Block and 1 Safe-Conduct.

cup_of_the_lowest_mark.FlavorText: The first turn each fight you end with exactly one Energy unspent: heal 4, and one more card at your next hand.

red_linen_knot.FlavorText: Every fight opens with 8 Block and one Embalmed, and the first time the linen holds something in place you are wrapped again for 8.

blank_cartouche.FlavorText: An extra card in your first hand. The first Inscribed you gain each fight finds no name to be written under and comes off again.

jar_of_borrowed_breath.FlavorText: The first affliction to leave you completely each fight is breath given back: heal 3, and one more card at your next hand.

broken_royal_weight.FlavorText: Every fight opens with 10 Block. The first measure you miss is taken on the weight instead: 10 Block at your next hand, and one Burdened.

petition_chisel.FlavorText: Every enemy action that marks you is one Grievance, at most 3. At the start of a turn with 3: draw 2, take a Spare Hand, and one affliction loses a stack.

tablet_of_the_missing_name.FlavorText: Every fight opens with one Nameless Authority: the first blessing you gain lands one stack larger. If the register holds you afterwards, 1 Inscribed comes off.

funerary_linen_coil.FlavorText: The first card each fight you put out of the fight yourself — archived, exhausted, banished, never merely played — heals 4 and draws 1. Junk is not worth the linen.

mercy_counterweight.FlavorText: At your first hand each fight, choose a pan: mercy, and the first affliction lands one stack lighter; or payment, and it pays a Spare Hand and a card at your next hand.

unfinished_docket.FlavorText: At the end of your turn, store up to 1 unspent Energy. You gain it next turn.

red_ribboned_matter.FlavorText: At the end of your turn, keep 1 card in hand. It costs 1 less next turn.

backlog_counterseal.FlavorText: At the end of your turn, gain 4 Block for each card left in your hand, up to 8.

brass_service_bell.FlavorText: At the start of every third turn, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card.

priority_sash.FlavorText: The first time each turn you deal 15 or more damage, gain 8 Block.

ivory_number_disc.FlavorText: Two enemy turns in a row without losing HP: gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card.

access_seal_shard.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 extra card.

testimony_seal_shard.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 8 Block and refuse the first negative status applied to you.

execution_seal_shard.FlavorText: Your first Deed each turn deals 4 additional damage.

stamped_expedition_writ.FlavorText: Once per combat, when you run out of Energy with cards in hand, gain 2 Energy.

civic_entry_warrant.FlavorText: Once per combat, when you run out of Energy with cards in hand, gain 1 Energy and strip every enemy's Block.

inspectors_brass_charter.FlavorText: At the start of each combat, gain 8 Block.

continuance_fragment.FlavorText: At the end of your turn, up to 8 Block carries into your next turn.

right_of_redress.FlavorText: The first time you have lost 12 HP in a combat, your next turn opens with 15 Block and 2 cards.

margin_of_appeal.FlavorText: Once per combat, the enemies' next turn is appealed: they deal half damage.

errata_ribbon.FlavorText: Play 3+ cards or fewer than 3 — change from last turn for 1 Energy, repeat it for 6 Block.

index_of_contradictions.FlavorText: The first time each turn you play a card of a different type than the one before, draw 1 and gain 3 Block.

registry_tab.FlavorText: The type you played most on turn 1 is registered: its first card each turn costs 1 less.

custody_shackle.FlavorText: End a turn having played 2 cards or fewer and 1 card stays in hand, free next turn.

master_release_key.FlavorText: On turn 1, seal a card of your choice in hand. Next turn it costs 0.

release_tag.FlavorText: After each draw, 1 card in hand costs 1 less and gains you 4 Block when played.

misdated_pocket_watch.FlavorText: Your last turn pays this one: no cards → 8 Block, 1–2 → 1 Energy, 3+ → draw 1.

borrowed_minute.FlavorText: Borrow 1 Energy at the start of a turn; the next turn repays it and gains 4 Block.

deferred_appointment_book.FlavorText: Turn 2: draw 2. Turn 3: gain 2 Energy. Turn 4: gain 15 Block.

identity_writ.FlavorText: The first time each turn you play a second card of the same type, draw 1. If you never do, gain 5 Block at the end of the turn.

settled_ledger.FlavorText: Every 4 Energy you spend on cards returns 1 Energy.

closure_writ.FlavorText: After winning a combat, heal a quarter of the health you are missing, up to 10.

premise_slip.FlavorText: Your first card each turn is a premise: cards of other types cost 1 less until you follow it, and following it in kind gains 6 Block.

concordance_thread.FlavorText: After each draw, 1 card in hand is threaded: playing it draws a card that costs 1 less this turn.

conclusion_leaf.FlavorText: The last card type you played decides your next turn: Deed → your first Deed deals 8 more, Working → 8 Block, Rite → draw 1.

boundary_tally.FlavorText: The road and the root take it in turns: on a road turn your first real card costs 1 less, on a root turn you open with 10 Block.

counter_petition_twine.FlavorText: Once a turn you may re-argue a card: discard one, draw one, and gain 1 Energy.

signed_settlement.FlavorText: Come through an enemy turn untouched for 1 Energy and a card; come through it hurt for 8 Block.

countersealed_ring_of_passage.FlavorText: Your first real card each turn sets a price; the next card at that price is refunded. A turn with no match ends in 5 Block.

countersealed_ring_of_restraint.FlavorText: Play three real cards and the fourth is refunded and draws a card. A turn that never reaches three keeps the ring armed.

countersealed_ring_of_keeping.FlavorText: Empty your hand of real cards and the next turn opens with 1 Energy and two extra cards; keep something back and one card stays, cheaper.

honey_spoon.FlavorText: Once a turn you may take 2 Energy. End that turn with at least 1 Energy, or it costs you 6 HP.

better_chair_cushion.FlavorText: Once a turn you may take 14 Block. End that turn holding a real card, or it costs you 6 HP.

last_slice_tin.FlavorText: Once a turn you may draw 2. Play no more than four real cards that turn, or it costs you 6 HP.

surveyed_milestone.FlavorText: The largest thing on the field is a landmark: first bringing it past three quarters, half and a quarter grants 1 Energy and a card.

survey_cairn.FlavorText: End a turn with 12 Block or more and the cairn buries twelve of it; the next turn opens with 1 Energy and a card.

loadstone_cairn.FlavorText: What the enemies take out of you is weight in the stone: next turn it is Block, and it is on your first Deed. Up to 12.

royal_grace_cup.FlavorText: Once a turn the cup offers an Energy, a card or 10 Block. Take it and every enemy guards for 6.

hollow_court_token.FlavorText: Spending your purse to the bottom is remembered, up to three times; open a turn owed all three and it pays 1 Energy, two cards and 8 Block.

silver_name_tally.FlavorText: Once a combat: one enemy's guard is gone, you gain 10 Block against what it was about to do, and your next card that turn is refunded.

crown_of_the_three_names.FlavorText: Every turn is worth one more Energy.

edict_of_the_open_audience.FlavorText: Once a combat, every card in your hand is heard for nothing.

eternal_cartouche.FlavorText: The first blow that would end you does not: you stand again, clean of every affliction, and the cartouche is spent for good.

feather_of_perfect_measure.FlavorText: Whichever kind you lead with costs 1 less, and the first answer in the other kind draws 1 and gains 8 Block.

acquittal_scarab.FlavorText: Every third turn the court sits: enemy guards fall and you strike 30% harder. You read one judgment further ahead than anyone else.

balance_of_the_two_pans.FlavorText: End a turn with as many Deeds as Workings, one of each at least, to heal 2 and open the next turn with an Energy. An unbalanced turn ends in 12 Block.

impossible_capstone.FlavorText: Half of whatever Block you still hold at the end of a turn is still there at the start of the next.

pyramidion_of_repetition.FlavorText: Every sixth real card you play in a fight happens twice, and the second time is free.

crooked_plumb_line.FlavorText: The first time in a turn you follow a card with one of another kind, up to 2 Energy comes back. A turn that never bends ends in 10 Block.

black_granary_key.FlavorText: Energy you do not spend is stored, and it comes back the moment you run out.

granary_reserve_seal.FlavorText: Every fight you win puts 15 HP back.

ration_seal.FlavorText: The fourth real card of a turn is free and draws you another. A turn that never gets there ends in 10 Block.

palimpsest_reed.FlavorText: The first real card you play each turn is copied down; the copy is in your hand next turn, and it is free.

erasure_tablet.FlavorText: Once a combat you may erase what the enemies were about to do; they guard for 20 instead.

correction_reed.FlavorText: Once a turn you may correct the record: a card away, a card back out of the discard pile, and the one you take back comes cheaper.

canopic_cabinet.FlavorText: The fight opens with 12 Block, and the first two afflictions laid on you are refused outright.

resin_shroud.FlavorText: Once a fight, coming round below half your health strips every affliction and wraps you in 25 Block.

basin_of_black_natron.FlavorText: Each turn the basin washes a stack off one of your afflictions — or gives you 12 Block if you have none.

triune_office_seal.FlavorText: All three offices answer to you: an extra card each turn, 8 more on your first Deed, and 8 Block on your first Working.

staff_of_the_kings_mouth.FlavorText: The first real card of each turn is paid for out of the King's own purse, up to 2 Energy.

vacant_throne_decree.FlavorText: Once a combat, the empty throne pays: 3 Energy, three cards and 20 Block.

sluice_gate_of_the_two_lands.FlavorText: Once a turn you may work the gate: 12 Block into an Energy, or an Energy into 12 Block.

flood_reckoning_crown.FlavorText: How you ended decides how you open: dry, and the crown pays an Energy and a card; with something left, an Energy and 15 Block. The first turn opens with 10 Block.

black_flood_vessel.FlavorText: Once a combat you may pour the whole hand away and draw seven fresh ones, with 2 Energy to spend on them.

paperwork.FlavorText: At the end of the enemy turn, this character loses HP equal to its Paperwork. This ignores Block.

doubt.FlavorText: The next attack made by this character deals 25% less damage. One stack is removed when this triggers.

panic.FlavorText: At the start of the player's turn, draw 1 fewer card. One stack is removed when this triggers.

fatigue.FlavorText: At the start of the player's turn, lose 1 Energy. One stack is removed when this triggers.

strength.FlavorText: This character's attacks deal additional damage equal to its Strength.

bookworm.FlavorText: Immediately before this enemy's Paperwork resolves, remove up to X Paperwork from it and the same number of Bookworm stacks. Bookworm remains if there is no Paperwork.

poison.FlavorText: At the end of the enemy turn, loses HP equal to Poison, then Poison is reduced by 1.

Extra.divineRule: What is written on the first tablet has already happened. Nisaba writes, and the room agrees afterwards.
Everything in this room is entered in the ledger as belonging to Inanna. She is not attacking you. She is collecting.
Every share in this room is measured against the just ration. What is over is taken back; what is short is owed.
The moon is a schedule. Whatever it is due on the day it arrives, it takes on that day and no other.
Utu witnesses every oath, including the ones you did not know you were swearing. Nothing done here goes unrecorded.
Enlil says a thing, and it is so. A decree is not an attack — it is the state the world is in from now on.
